_about: Example customer profile. Copy this folder to profiles/<yourcompany>/ and edit, then install with --customer <yourcompany>. When the agent runs on the same Linux box as the site, site_url is the local web port and host_header the site name. Secrets are typed in by the installer - never commit them here.

sources._note: eSSL Time Pro / Easy Time Pro / BioTime keep punches in iclock_transaction (this block). eTimeTrackLite keeps one table per month: replace table with "table_pattern": "DeviceLogs_{m}_{Y}", user_column UserId, time_column LogDate, serial_column DeviceId, state_column Direction. Engine is mssql for SQL Server. Only if the readers feed a vendor attendance database. If the readers are ZKTeco/eSSL devices reachable on the LAN (port 4370), delete this block and register them in GroHR with driver 'ZKTeco' - no database needed.
